{{Quotation|game|
A small community on the edge of the Highlands, Tihark Orchard was settled by a group of retired gardeners of Seborhin. Through horticulture and careful irrigation, they have made this rugged upland bloom.
}}
[[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]] lies outside and overlooks the exclusive [[Garden of Seborhin]].

== Getting there ==
The [[primary quest]] [[Rally The Princes]] concludes at this outpost and continues with the mission here.

== Exits ==
* [[Forum Highlands]] (northwest and southeast)
